resources.string:
Thank you for playing College Football Head Coach (CFHC)! 

Please share any feedback to the developer on how to improve this game! 

 v1.4 
+ New Dashboard UI 
+ Added Offensive and Defensive Coordinators 
+ New Player and Coaching Profiles 
+ Year-by-Year Stats 
+ Updated Transfers Dialogs 
+ In-Game Injuries 
+ Several game tweaks and code re-writes 
+ Ability to Cut Players 
+ Convert to Pro-Rel in Preseason 

 v1.4.33 
+ Added Coaching Age Import Feature 

 v1.4.5 
+ Expanded test coverage: box score invariants, standings, awards, depth chart, progression, transfers, recruiting, and career lifecycle 
+ Desktop theme polish and dark mode improvements 
+ Cross-platform cleanup: Android-only recruiting UI classes separated 
+ Null-safety and dead code removal across desktop and shared engine 
+ Save/load robustness improvements
